links.outcome: Rater-scored LLM vs textbook responses on accuracy, thoroughness, usefulness, brevity, quality
links.effect: LLMs rated more thorough (p<0.001) but less concise (p<0.001) than textbooks; textbooks superior on contraindications (p=0.027) and complications (p=0.014); ChatGPT outperformed Gemini.
links.quote: LLM responses were rated as more thorough (p < 0.001) but less concise (p < 0.001) than textbook responses.

unlisted_practices: Comparing LLM responses with traditional textbooks for surgical trainee case preparation

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating ChatGPT-4 and Gemini compared to traditional textbooks for plastic surgery surgical education and case preparation using clinician reader surveys.
